question: What byte allowance does VPC.KR attach to Korea VPS - Mini at order time?
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. vpc.kr/order/vps?product=2 redirects (302) to vpc.kr/login, and an archived copy dated 2026-05-26 is the login form. The pricing page states 5Mbps Dedicated Bandwidth and no allowance (unchanged since an archived copy of 2026-04-17), the homepage repeats 10Gbps Bandwidth on all three plan tiles, two blog posts dated Mar 23, 2026 state 1TB with 1GB RAM and 20GB SSD, and a third blog post of that date states 512MB RAM and 10GB SSD with no bandwidth. Only an account's order screen or invoice can settle it: an operator step.
